fields.name: placements_done
fields.description: Integer count of completed placements of the goal-colored cube onto the target so far in the episode, counting the placement shown in this step's execution steps. It is 0 at step #1 and at every step whose execution steps do not contain a release of the cube over the target. It increases by exactly one at each decision step whose execution steps show the cube held in the gripper, then the fingers opening to ~100% while the gripper is low (height below about 0.03) at the target position, leaving the cube resting on the target (the step whose correct subgoal follows a 'place' command). It never decreases. e.g. 1
